_doc: The playbook's tested Citizen opening, step 1 (docs/research/playbook.md section 12) as data for tools/orig/opening.py. Menu positions and costs measured in the Wine runner 2026-10-22 (T16) from the original's construction menu: categories in the left column, the building grid, tooltips and each building's panel (tools, wood, bricks, marble, gold; upkeep). Screen positions are frame fractions for the Citizen start camera (the same in every run: the player's Kontor at about (0.38, 0.47)); each building has a preferred spot and is tried at candidates around it until the city's store and the player's money show the placement.
_costs: cost = the building panel in the running game (Wine runner 2026-10-22); identical to Anlagen.dat HEAD (gold u16 [8], materials bytes [3..6]) for every id below, as tabled in docs/research/playbook.md section 14. upkeep = the panel's running cost = the larger PROD3 value.

candidates._note: rings around the preferred spot: offsets in frame fractions, tried in order

steps._src: 4 foresters in a row (playbook 12.1); the first spot was placed and verified in a live session
a road from the foresters toward the Kontor
